title: Why does TCP have TIME_WAIT, and what does it protect?

cast.name: Nova
cast.role: Ops engineer who files a bug on sight

cast.name: Kit
cast.role: Network engineer, patient, has read the RFC

glossary.note: The TCP flag that says "I am done sending".
How long a segment may live in the network.

key_points: The side that closes first waits in TIME_WAIT for twice the maximum segment lifetime.
It lets a lost final ACK be answered and lets stray old segments expire.
tcp_tw_reuse helps outgoing connections without removing the protection.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A busy server shows a pile of sockets in TIME_WAIT. Nova files a bug.

visuals.text: claim: TIME_WAIT is a leak, so turn it off

beats.say: A busy server shows a pile of sockets in time wait. Nova files a bug.

beats.speaker: nova
beats.text: These sockets are dead. TIME_WAIT is a leak. Let's switch it off.
beats.say: These sockets are dead. time wait is a leak. Let's switch it off.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.text: First: who ends up in TIME_WAIT? Whoever closes first.
beats.say: First: who ends up in time wait? Whoever closes first.

beats.speaker: nova
beats.text: After that last ACK, it's finished. Why keep the socket?

beats.speaker: kit
beats.text: Reason one. If that last ACK is lost, the server resends its FIN. The client must still exist to answer, or it replies with a reset.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.text: Old segments. A delayed packet from the dead connection could arrive after a new one reuses the same four-tuple: both addresses and both ports.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.text: So the client waits twice the maximum segment lifetime. Linux fixes that at sixty seconds, compiled in.

beats.speaker: nova
beats.text: Fine. But my client runs out of ports.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.text: Then tcp_tw_reuse lets new outgoing connections reuse a TIME_WAIT socket, using TCP timestamps to reject old segments.
beats.say: Then T C P T W reuse lets new outgoing connections reuse a time wait socket, using TCP timestamps to reject old segments.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.text: It's a guarantee with a timer.
